title: The Sacred Star

sources.title: Turned (condition)
markers: The condition ends upon taking damage

summary: A +2 morningstar with Radiant damage, Radiating Orbs and anti-Undead powers.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d8 + 2 Piercing plus Strength and 1d4 Radiant. +2 to attack. Martial, one-handed, 5 ft melee. The item template also lists a two-handed damage value but labels it one-handed.
fields.Radiant Strike: Hits with this weapon apply Radiating Orb for 1 turn. Each remaining turn penalizes attack rolls by 1.
fields.Sanctified Weapon: On hit, Undead must pass DC 13 Wisdom save or be Turned for 3 turns. Turned creatures flee and cannot willingly approach within 30 ft. Their actions are limited to Dash or escape attempts. They cannot spend Reactions, and damage ends the effect.
fields.Tenacity: Main hand, Reaction on missed melee attack. Deal Bludgeoning equal to Strength modifier, minimum 1. The item notes a possible Radiant Strike and Sanctified Weapon interaction, still unverified. If a weapon action misses, this reaction does not apply that action’s effect.
fields.Heartstopper: Action with proficiency once per Short Rest. Melee attack for 1d4 + attack ability modifier Piercing. Constitution save vs weapon-action DC +2 prevents 2 turns of Chest Trauma, which removes one Action while leaving Bonus Actions and Reactions.
fields.Concussive Smash: Action with proficiency once per Short Rest. Melee weapon damage. Constitution save vs the higher of spell save DC or weapon-action DC +2 avoids Dazed for 2 turns. Dazed removes Dexterity AC bonus and reactions that spend the Reaction resource and gives disadvantage on Wisdom saves. Help ends it.
fields.Dawnburst Strike: Action with proficiency once per Short Rest. On hit add proficiency bonus Radiant and erupt in a 10 ft radius. Constitution save vs weapon-action DC +2 prevents Blinded for 3 turns. The burst can affect allies and excludes the original target. The Radiant component is a separate damage source even in Honour Mode. Blinded gives Disadvantage on attacks, grants Advantage to attackers, limits sight-dependent attacks and spells to 10 ft, and prevents Opportunity Attacks.
fields.Acquisition: Vicar Humbletoes at Stormshore Tabernacle, X 107, Y −22.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
